description: The Classic tower-one at four stars (the towerone fixture with star raised to four and the treasury filled) runs at hour ticks until a bomb threat is called in and refuses the ransom, so Security searches the tower against the 1:00 PM deadline; the run goes on two days so the search ends, found or not. A refused ransom that settles at once (the bug #349 fixed) moves this scenario's checkpoints.
